1. Study enemy patterns and attack timings through repeated encounters
2. Upgrade your weapons at blacksmiths using titanite shards
3. Level up your character focusing on vitality endurance and your primary damage stat
4. Summon other players or NPCs for boss fights when struggling
5. Explore thoroughly to find shortcuts bonfires and hidden items
6. Manage your stamina bar carefully during combat encounters
7. Learn to parry and riposte humanoid enemies for massive damage
8. Use the environment to your advantage by fighting enemies one at a time
